verdict.rationale: The Drive API reference and discovery document are published under explicit version paths (/rest/v3 and /apis/drive/v3), so the product does ship a versioned API. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-migration guidance, and the versioning itself shows only in URLs, not in explanatory docs. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, a versioning or lifecycle statement, deprecation notice periods or changelog, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The Google Drive API allows clients to access resources from Google Drive.
